units.text:
Instruction for installing pumps
with flange support(s)
(also applies to horizontal pumps)
units.display_text: Instruction for installing pumps with flange support(s) (also applies to horizontal pumps)

units.text: 1. Fasten the pump to the underlying structure (= foundation / concrete plinth / floor) and check that the pump is level.
units.display_text: 1. Fasten the pump to the underlying structure (= foundation / concrete plinth / floor) and check that the pump is level.

source_spans.text: 1. Fasten the pump to the underlying structure (= foundation / concrete plinth / floor) and check that the pump is level.

units.text: 2. Check that the pump shaft can be rotated freely - i.e. by hand without noise and abnormal resistance.
units.display_text: 2. Check that the pump shaft can be rotated freely - i.e. by hand without noise and abnormal resistance.

source_spans.text: 2. Check that the pump shaft can be rotated freely - i.e. by hand without noise and abnormal resistance.

units.text:
3. Place flange support(s) at the pump’s flange(s) and check that the bolt holes are aligned and that the gasket surfaces
are parallel.
units.display_text: 3. Place flange support(s) at the pump’s flange(s) and check that the bolt holes are aligned and that the gasket surfaces are parallel.

source_spans.text: 3. Place flange support(s) at the pump’s flange(s) and check that the bolt holes are aligned and that the gasket surfaces

units.text:
4. If the underlying structure is not level (plane), it may be necessary to shim under either the pump footplate or under
the flange support(s).
units.display_text: 4. If the underlying structure is not level (plane), it may be necessary to shim under either the pump footplate or under the flange support(s).

source_spans.text: 4. If the underlying structure is not level (plane), it may be necessary to shim under either the pump footplate or under

units.text:
5. Insert gasket(s) between pump and flange support(s) and hold together and parallel with 4 temporary bolts 90° offset
in each flange.
units.display_text: 5. Insert gasket(s) between pump and flange support(s) and hold together and parallel with 4 temporary bolts 90° offset in each flange.

source_spans.text: 5. Insert gasket(s) between pump and flange support(s) and hold together and parallel with 4 temporary bolts 90° offset

units.text:
6. Check that the flange support(s) have full contact with the underlying structure (if there is more than a 0.5 mm air gap
under the feet, shims must be placed underneath)
units.display_text: 6. Check that the flange support(s) have full contact with the underlying structure (if there is more than a 0.5 mm air gap under the feet, shims must be placed underneath)

source_spans.text: 6. Check that the flange support(s) have full contact with the underlying structure (if there is more than a 0.5 mm air gap
under the feet, shims must be placed underneath)

units.text: 7. Bolt flange support(s) to underlying structure.
units.display_text: 7. Bolt flange support(s) to underlying structure.

source_spans.text: 7. Bolt flange support(s) to underlying structure.

units.text: 8. Remove the 4 temporary bolts and mount the pipe system flange(s) and gasket(s) against the flange support(s).
units.display_text: 8. Remove the 4 temporary bolts and mount the pipe system flange(s) and gasket(s) against the flange support(s).

source_spans.text: 8. Remove the 4 temporary bolts and mount the pipe system flange(s) and gasket(s) against the flange support(s).

units.text: 9. Check that the bolt holes are aligned and that the gasket surfaces are parallel.
units.display_text: 9. Check that the bolt holes are aligned and that the gasket surfaces are parallel.

source_spans.text: 9. Check that the bolt holes are aligned and that the gasket surfaces are parallel.

units.text: 10. Bolt the piping system flange(s) together with the pump and flange support(s).
units.display_text: 10. Bolt the piping system flange(s) together with the pump and flange support(s).

source_spans.text: 10. Bolt the piping system flange(s) together with the pump and flange support(s).

units.text:
11. Check that the pump shaft still can be rotated freely (sound and resistance must not have changed according to point
2).
units.display_text: 11. Check that the pump shaft still can be rotated freely (sound and resistance must not have changed according to point 2).

source_spans.text: 11. Check that the pump shaft still can be rotated freely (sound and resistance must not have changed according to point

units.text:
12. If the temperature of the pipe system changes significantly (up or down) after commissioning the pump and consequent
thermal stresses / movements in the pipe system, if any, can be transferred to the pump, it should be checked again
that the pump shaft still can rotate freely at actual upper/lower temperature limits.
units.display_text: 12. If the temperature of the pipe system changes significantly (up or down) after commissioning the pump and consequent thermal stresses / movements in the pipe system, if any, can be transferred to the pump, it should be checked again that the pump shaft still can rotate freely at actual upper/lower temperature limits.

source_spans.text: 12. If the temperature of the pipe system changes significantly (up or down) after commissioning the pump and consequent
thermal stresses / movements in the pipe system, if any, can be transferred to the pump, it should be checked again
that the pump shaft still can rotate freely at actual upper/lower temperature limits.

units.text:
13. If the pump cannot rotate freely under all operating conditions, the pipe system must be better supported - alternatively,
compensator(s) must be installed between the pump and pipe system.
units.display_text: 13. If the pump cannot rotate freely under all operating conditions, the pipe system must be better supported - alternatively, compensator(s) must be installed between the pump and pipe system.

source_spans.text: 13. If the pump cannot rotate freely under all operating conditions, the pipe system must be better supported - alternatively,
compensator(s) must be installed between the pump and pipe system.
